in_sanskrit.name: शरयनी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: शर शेषनाथे अनन्तरागते अनन्ता रूपे विजया निधने नमस्ते शरयनी, meaning 'Goddess of Victory who resides in the infinite, indestructible, and imperishable form of Shiva.'

in_tamil.name: சரயானி
in_tamil.long_meaning: விஜயம் அடிகள் கொண்ட அலையில் இருந்த தின் அலை, meaning 'Goddess of Victory who holds the weapons of victory'

in_telugu.name: శరయనీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: జీవనేశ్వరదేశీ జీవితమేధే జీవితమేధేశీ, meaning 'Goddess of Victory who is the Goddess of life and the Goddess of life itself'

in_marathi.name: Sharayani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Protection
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharayani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess Sharayani is the embodiment of divine motherly love and protection. She is often invoked during times of crisis to seek her blessings and guidance. Her name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shara', which means protection, and 'Yani', which means goddess.
